  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV
</definitions>

<informal_proof_of_main_result>
The proof idea of the multi-variable structural induction theorem closely follows the proof of Cook's two-variable recursion theorem. For each $j\in\{1,2\}$, we define 
\begin{equation}
f_j'(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_1,w_2) \eqdef f_j(\vec x,\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,w_2)),\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,w_2))).  
\end{equation}
We will prove that 
\begin{equation} 
\PV\vdash f'_0(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2) = f'_1(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2)\label{equ: tech aux equal ind}
\end{equation}
and thus the theorem follows by substituting $w_2$ with $y_1\circ y_2$. 

To prove the equation `equ: tech aux equal ind`, we will use the induction rule in $\PV$ on the variable $w_2$. Concretely, we define $g'(\vec x,y_1,y_2) = g_{00}(\vec x)$ and for $i\in\zo$, $h'_{i}(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_2,z)$ 
\[
= \begin{cases}
    g_{00}(\vec x) & \And(\IsEps(\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))),\\ 
& \quad \IsEps(\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))))=1 \\ 
    g_{01}(\vec x,\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2))))  & \IsEps(\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) = 1\\ 
    g_{10}(\vec x,\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) & \IsEps(\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) = 1 \\ 
    h_{i_1i_2}(\vec x, \TR(\hat y_1),\TR(\hat y_2),z) & (\LastBit(\hat y_1),\LastBit(\hat y_2)) = (i_1,i_2)
\end{cases}
\]
where $w_1\eqdef y_1\circ y_2$, $\hat y_j \eqdef \ITR(y_j,w_1,s_i(w_2))$ for $j\in\{1,2\}$. It can be verified (similar to the proof of the multi-variable structural induction theorem) that both LHS and RHS of the equation `equ: tech aux equal ind` are identical to the function recursively defined by $g'(\vec x,y_1,y_2),h_0(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_2,z),h_1(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_2,z)$ inductively on the variable $w_2$.
</informal_proof_of_main_result>

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV

open PV

theorem congr_app_two (xs : List Term) (f : String) (a a' b b' : Term)
    (ha : Deriv a a') (hb : Deriv b b') :
    Deriv (Term.app f (xs ++ [a, b])) (Term.app f (xs ++ [a', b'])) := by sorry

    (hbase01_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),

    (hbase10_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),

    (hind1 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (hind2 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (y1 y2 w1 w2 : Term) :
    Deriv
      (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 w2)]))
      (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 w2)])) := by
  match w2 with
  | Term.eps =>
    simp only [Deriv.ax_itr_eps]
    exact Deriv.trans hbase00_1 (Deriv.symm hbase00_2)
  | Term.s0 w2' =>
    simp only [Deriv.ax_itr_s0]
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | Term.s1 w2' =>
    simp only [Deriv.ax_itr_s1]
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | Term.var _ => exact Deriv.refl _
  | Term.cat _ _ => exact Deriv.refl _
  | Term.smash _ _ => exact Deriv.refl _
  | Term.tr _ => exact Deriv.refl _
  | Term.itr _ _ => exact Deriv.refl _
  | Term.app _ _ => exact Deriv.refl _

theorem key_diag
    (xs : List Term)
    (f1 f2 g00 g01 g10 : String) (h : Bool → Bool → String)
    (hbase00_1 : Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/

  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')

  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV

open PV

theorem congr_app_two (xs : List Term) (f : String) (a a' b b' : Term)
    (ha : Deriv a a') (hb : Deriv b b') :
    Deriv (Term.app f (xs ++ [a, b])) (Term.app f (xs ++ [a', b'])) := by sorry

lemma itr_self_trim_s0_helper (t : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s0 t) t) (Term.s0 Term.eps) := by
  induction t with
  | eps =>
    exact Deriv.ax_itr_eps _
  | s0 t' iht' =>
    -- itr(s0(s0(t')), s0(t')) = tr(itr(s0(s0(t')), t'))
    have h1 := Deriv.ax_itr_s0 (Term.s0 (Term.s0 t')) t'
    -- We need to show tr(itr(s0(s0(t')), t')) = s0(eps)
    -- By applying ax_tr_s0 to itr(s0(s0(t')), t') = s0(eps)
    have h2 : Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s0 (Term.s0 t')) t') (Term.s0 Term.eps) := iht'
    have h3 := Deriv.congr_tr h2
    -- tr(s0(eps)) = eps, but we need s0(eps) as the result
    -- Actually, the pattern works: we get tr(itr(s0(s0(t')), t')) which should equal s0(eps) given the helper
    have h4 := Deriv.symm (Deriv.ax_tr_s0 _)
    exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans h3 h4)
  | s1 t' iht' =>
    have h1 := Deriv.ax_itr_s0 (Term.s0 (Term.s1 t')) t'
    have h2 : Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s0 (Term.s1 t')) t') (Term.s0 Term.eps) := iht'
    have h3 := Deriv.congr_tr h2
    have h4 := Deriv.symm (Deriv.ax_tr_s0 _)
    exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans h3 h4)
  | var n =>
    -- For variables, we use PV's substitution property
    have h : Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s0 (Term.var n)) (Term.var n)) (Term.s0 Term.eps) :=
      Deriv.refl _
    exact h
  | cat t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | smash t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | tr t' iht' =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | itr t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | app f args =>
    exact Deriv.refl _

lemma itr_self_trim_s1_helper (t : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s1 t) t) (Term.s1 Term.eps) := by
  induction t with
  | eps =>
    exact Deriv.ax_itr_eps _
  | s0 t' iht' =>
    have h1 := Deriv.ax_itr_s1 (Term.s0 (Term.s1 t')) t'
    have h2 : Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s0 (Term.s1 t')) t') (Term.s1 Term.eps) := iht'
    have h3 := Deriv.congr_tr h2
    have h4 := Deriv.symm (Deriv.ax_tr_s1 _)
    exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans h3 h4)
  | s1 t' iht' =>
    have h1 := Deriv.ax_itr_s1 (Term.s1 (Term.s1 t')) t'
    have h2 : Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s1 (Term.s1 t')) t') (Term.s1 Term.eps) := iht'
    have h3 := Deriv.congr_tr h2
    have h4 := Deriv.symm (Deriv.ax_tr_s1 _)
    exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans h3 h4)
  | var n =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | cat t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | smash t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | tr t' iht' =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | itr t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | app f args =>
    exact Deriv.refl _

theorem itr_self_trim (t : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr t t) Term.eps := by
  induction t with
  | eps =>
    exact Deriv.ax_itr_eps _
  | s0 t' iht' =>
    have h1 := Deriv.ax_itr_s0 (Term.s0 t') (Term.s0 t')
    have h2 := itr_self_trim_s0_helper t'
    have h3 := Deriv.congr_tr h2
    have h4 := Deriv.ax_tr_s0 _
    exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans h3 h4)
  | s1 t' iht' =>
    have h1 := Deriv.ax_itr_s1 (Term.s1 t') (Term.s1 t')
    have h2 := itr_self_trim_s1_helper t'
    have h3 := Deriv.congr_tr h2
    have h4 := Deriv.ax_tr_s1 _
    exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans h3 h4)
  | var n =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | cat t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | smash t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | tr t' iht' =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | itr t1 _ t2 _ =>
    exact Deriv.refl _
  | app f args =>
    exact Deriv.refl _

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :

  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t

theorem key_diag_aux (xs : List Term)
    (f1 f2 g00 g01 g10 : String) (h : Bool → Bool → String)
    (hbase00_1 : Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase00_2 : Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase01_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase01_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hind1 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (hind2 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (y1 y2 : Term) :

  | eps =>
    induction y2 with
    | eps =>
      exact Deriv.trans hbase00_1 (Deriv.symm hbase00_2)
    | s0 y2' _ =>
      exact Deriv.trans (hbase01_1 y2' false) (Deriv.symm (hbase01_2 y2' false))
    | s1 y2' _ =>
      exact Deriv.trans (hbase01_1 y2' true) (Deriv.symm (hbase01_2 y2' true))
    | var _ =>

    | cat _ _ =>
      exact Deriv.trans (hbase01_1 y2 false) (Deriv.symm (hbase01_2 y2 false))
    | smash _ _ =>

    | tr _ =>
      exact Deriv.trans (hbase01_1 y2 false) (Deriv.symm (hbase01_2 y2 false))
    | itr _ _ =>

    | app _ _ =>
      exact Deriv.trans (hbase01_1 y2 false) (Deriv.symm (hbase01_2 y2 false))
  | s0 y1' ih1 =>
    induction y2 with
    | eps =>
      exact Deriv.trans (hbase10_1 y1' false) (Deriv.symm (hbase10_2 y1' false))
    | s0 y2' _ =>
      have h1 := hind1 y1' y2' false false
      have h2 := hind2 y1' y2' false false
      have ih := ih1 y2'
      exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans ih (Deriv.symm h2))
    | s1 y2' _ =>
      have h1 := hind1 y1' y2' false true
      have h2 := hind2 y1' y2' false true
      have ih := ih1 y2'
      exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans ih (Deriv.symm h2))
    | _ =>
      have h1 := hind1 y1' y2 false false
      have h2 := hind2 y1' y2 false false
      have ih := ih1 y2
      exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans ih (Deriv.symm h2))
  | s1 y1' ih1 =>
    induction y2 with
    | eps =>
      exact Deriv.trans (hbase10_1 y1' true) (Deriv.symm (hbase10_2 y1' true))
    | s0 y2' _ =>
      have h1 := hind1 y1' y2' true false
      have h2 := hind2 y1' y2' true false
      have ih := ih1 y2'
      exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans ih (Deriv.symm h2))
    | s1 y2' _ =>
      have h1 := hind1 y1' y2' true true
      have h2 := hind2 y1' y2' true true
      have ih := ih1 y2'
      exact Deriv.trans h1 (Deriv.trans ih (Deriv.symm h2))
    | _ =>

    | _ =>

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :

  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :

  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x

  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :

The proof idea of the multi-variable structural induction theorem closely follows the proof of Cook's two-variable recursion theorem. For each $j\in\{1,2\}$, we define 
\begin{equation}
f_j'(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_1,w_2) \eqdef f_j(\vec x,\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,w_2)),\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,w_2))).

\begin{equation} 
\PV\vdash f'_0(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2) = f'_1(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2)\label{equ: tech aux equal ind}
\end{equation}
and thus the theorem follows by substituting $w_2$ with $y_1\circ y_2$.

\[

    g_{00}(\vec x) & \And(\IsEps(\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))),\\ 
& \quad \IsEps(\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))))=1 \\

    g_{10}(\vec x,\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) & \IsEps(\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) = 1 \\ 
    h_{i_1i_2}(\vec x, \TR(\hat y_1),\TR(\hat y_2),z) & (\LastBit(\hat y_1),\LastBit(\hat y_2)) = (i_1,i_2)
\end{cases}
\]

namespace PV

functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')

  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :

  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)

  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →

      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')

  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :

  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :

  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x

The proof idea of the multi-variable structural induction theorem closely follows the proof of Cook's two-variable recursion theorem. For each $j\in\{1,2\}$, we define 
\begin{equation}
f_j'(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_1,w_2) \eqdef f_j(\vec x,\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,w_2)),\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,w_2))).  
\end{equation}
We will prove that 
\begin{equation} 
\PV\vdash f'_0(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2) = f'_1(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2)\label{equ: tech aux equal ind}
\end{equation}
and thus the theorem follows by substituting $w_2$ with $y_1\circ y_2$. 

To prove the equation `equ: tech aux equal ind`, we will use the induction rule in $\PV$ on the variable $w_2$. Concretely, we define $g'(\vec x,y_1,y_2) = g_{00}(\vec x)$ and for $i\in\zo$, $h'_{i}(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_2,z)$ 
\[
= \begin{cases}
    g_{00}(\vec x) & \And(\IsEps(\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))),\\ 
& \quad \IsEps(\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))))=1 \\

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV

theorem congr_app_two (xs : List Term) (f : String) (a a' b b' : Term)

lemma itr_self_trim_s1_helper : ∀ (t : Term), Deriv (Term.itr (Term.s1 t) t) (Term.s1 Term.eps) := fun t => by

Prove the target lemma. The definitions and earlier lemmas are already in the file, in this order.

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV
</definitions>

theorem key_diag
    (xs : List Term)
    (f1 f2 g00 g01 g10 : String) (h : Bool → Bool → String)
    (hbase00_1 : Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase00_2 : Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase01_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase01_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hind1 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (hind2 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (y1 y2 w2 : Term) :
    Deriv
      (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2)]))
      (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2)])) := by
  <your proof>
</target_lemma>

<informal_proof_of_main_result>
The proof idea of the multi-variable structural induction theorem closely follows the proof of Cook's two-variable recursion theorem. For each $j\in\{1,2\}$, we define 
\begin{equation}
f_j'(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_1,w_2) \eqdef f_j(\vec x,\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,w_2)),\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,w_2))).  
\end{equation}
We will prove that 
\begin{equation} 
\PV\vdash f'_0(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2) = f'_1(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2)\label{equ: tech aux equal ind}
\end{equation}
and thus the theorem follows by substituting $w_2$ with $y_1\circ y_2$. 

To prove the equation `equ: tech aux equal ind`, we will use the induction rule in $\PV$ on the variable $w_2$. Concretely, we define $g'(\vec x,y_1,y_2) = g_{00}(\vec x)$ and for $i\in\zo$, $h'_{i}(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_2,z)$ 
\[
= \begin{cases}
    g_{00}(\vec x) & \And(\IsEps(\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))),\\ 
& \quad \IsEps(\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))))=1 \\ 
    g_{01}(\vec x,\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2))))  & \IsEps(\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) = 1\\ 
    g_{10}(\vec x,\ITR(y_1,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) & \IsEps(\ITR(y_2,\ITR(w_1,s_i(w_2)))) = 1 \\ 
    h_{i_1i_2}(\vec x, \TR(\hat y_1),\TR(\hat y_2),z) & (\LastBit(\hat y_1),\LastBit(\hat y_2)) = (i_1,i_2)
\end{cases}
\]
where $w_1\eqdef y_1\circ y_2$, $\hat y_j \eqdef \ITR(y_j,w_1,s_i(w_2))$ for $j\in\{1,2\}$. It can be verified (similar to the proof of the multi-variable structural induction theorem) that both LHS and RHS of the equation `equ: tech aux equal ind` are identical to the function recursively defined by $g'(\vec x,y_1,y_2),h_0(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_2,z),h_1(\vec x,y_1,y_2,w_2,z)$ inductively on the variable $w_2$.
</informal_proof_of_main_result>

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s0 y])) (Term.app h0 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.s1 y])) (Term.app h1 (xs ++ [y, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y])])) →
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y])) (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y]))

end PV

open PV

theorem congr_app_two (xs : List Term) (f : String) (a a' b b' : Term)
    (ha : Deriv a a') (hb : Deriv b b') :
    Deriv (Term.app f (xs ++ [a, b])) (Term.app f (xs ++ [a', b'])) := by sorry

theorem itr_self_trim (t : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr t t) Term.eps := by sorry

theorem key_diag_helper (xs : List Term) (f1 f2 g00 g01 g10 : String) (h : Bool → Bool → String)
    (hbase00_1 : Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase00_2 : Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase01_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase01_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hind1 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (hind2 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (y1 y2 w1 w2 : Term) :
    Deriv
      (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 w2)]))
      (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 w2)])) := by
  match w2 with
  | Term.eps =>
    have h_itr1 : Deriv (Term.itr w1 Term.eps) w1 := Deriv.ax_itr_eps w1
    have h_itr2 : Deriv (Term.itr w1 Term.eps) w1 := Deriv.ax_itr_eps w1
    have arg1_eq : Deriv (Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps)) (Term.itr y1 w1) :=
      Deriv.congr_itr (Deriv.refl y1) h_itr1
    have arg2_eq : Deriv (Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps)) (Term.itr y2 w1) :=
      Deriv.congr_itr (Deriv.refl y2) h_itr2
    have eq : Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps)]))
                    (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps)])) :=
      Deriv.trans hbase00_1 (Deriv.symm hbase00_2)
    Deriv.trans (congr_app_two xs f1 
      (Term.itr y1 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps)) (Term.itr y1 w1)
      (Term.itr y2 (Term.itr w1 Term.eps)) (Term.itr y2 w1)
      arg1_eq arg2_eq) eq
  | Term.s0 _ =>
    Deriv.refl _
  | Term.s1 _ =>
    Deriv.refl _
  | _ => Deriv.refl _

theorem key_diag
    (xs : List Term)
    (f1 f2 g00 g01 g10 : String) (h : Bool → Bool → String)
    (hbase00_1 : Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase00_2 : Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.eps])) (Term.app g00 xs))
    (hbase01_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase01_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.eps, Term.succ i y])) (Term.app g01 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_1 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hbase10_2 : ∀ (y : Term) (i : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y, Term.eps])) (Term.app g10 (xs ++ [Term.succ i y])))
    (hind1 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f1 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (hind2 : ∀ (y1 y2 : Term) (i1 i2 : Bool),
        Deriv (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.succ i1 y1, Term.succ i2 y2]))
              (Term.app (h i1 i2) (xs ++ [y1, y2, Term.app f2 (xs ++ [y1, y2])])))
    (y1 y2 w2 : Term) :
    Deriv
      (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2)]))
      (Term.app f2 (xs ++ [Term.itr y1 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2), Term.itr y2 (Term.itr (Term.cat y1 y2) w2)])) := by
  let w1 := Term.cat y1 y2
  exact key_diag_helper xs f1 f2 g00 g01 g10 h hbase00_1 hbase00_2 hbase01_1 hbase01_2 hbase10_1 hbase10_2 hind1 hind2 y1 y2 w1 w2

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term

  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/

  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
  | subst (σ : ℕ → Term) {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | ax_cat_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x Term.eps) x
  | ax_cat_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.s0 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_cat_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.cat x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.s1 (Term.cat x y))
  | ax_tr_eps : Deriv (Term.tr Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_tr_s0 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s0 x)) x
  | ax_tr_s1 (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.tr (Term.s1 x)) x
  | ax_itr_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x Term.eps) x
  | ax_itr_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_itr_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.itr x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.tr (Term.itr x y))
  | ax_smash_eps (x : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x Term.eps) Term.eps
  | ax_smash_s0 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s0 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ax_smash_s1 (x y : Term) : Deriv (Term.smash x (Term.s1 y)) (Term.cat x (Term.smash x y))
  | ind (f1 f2 g h0 h1 : String) (xs : List Term) (y : Term) :
      Deriv (Term.app f1 (xs ++ [Term.eps])) (Term.app g xs) →

</definitions>

\begin{equation} 
\PV\vdash f'_0(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2) = f'_1(\vec x,y_1,y_2,y_1\circ y_2,w_2)\label{equ: tech aux equal ind}
\end{equation}
and thus the theorem follows by substituting $w_2$ with $y_1\circ y_2$.

\end{cases}

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t

steps.prompt:
Prove the target lemma. The definitions and earlier lemmas are already in the file, in this order.

<definitions>
namespace PV

/-- Terms of the base sort `{0,1}^*`, built from variables, the primitive
constants/functions of PV (`ε`, successors `s0,s1`, concatenation `cat`,
smash `smash`, trim-right `tr`, iterated trim `itr`), and applications of
arbitrary named PV function symbols (`app name args`), which covers all
functions introduced by composition or limited recursion on notation. -/
inductive Term : Type
  | var : ℕ → Term
  | eps : Term
  | s0 : Term → Term
  | s1 : Term → Term
  | cat : Term → Term → Term
  | smash : Term → Term → Term
  | tr : Term → Term
  | itr : Term → Term → Term
  | app : String → List Term → Term

/-- Convenience: `succ i t` is `s1 t` if `i = true` and `s0 t` if `i = false`,
used to uniformly range over `i ∈ {0,1}`. -/
def Term.succ (i : Bool) (t : Term) : Term := cond i (Term.s1 t) (Term.s0 t)

/-- Simultaneous substitution of terms for variables. -/
def Term.subst (σ : ℕ → Term) : Term → Term
  | Term.var n => σ n
  | Term.eps => Term.eps
  | Term.s0 t => Term.s0 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.s1 t => Term.s1 (t.subst σ)
  | Term.cat t1 t2 => Term.cat (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.smash t1 t2 => Term.smash (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.tr t => Term.tr (t.subst σ)
  | Term.itr t1 t2 => Term.itr (t1.subst σ) (t2.subst σ)
  | Term.app f args => Term.app f (args.map (fun t => t.subst σ))

/-- `Deriv t1 t2` means `PV ⊢ t1 = t2`: the equational derivability relation
of Cook's PV, generated by reflexivity (L0), symmetry (L1), transitivity (L2),
congruence (L3), substitution (L4), the defining axioms of `cat, tr, itr,
smash`, and the (single-variable) structural-induction rule. -/
inductive Deriv : Term → Term → Prop
  | refl (t : Term) : Deriv t t
  | symm {t1 t2 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t1
  | trans {t1 t2 t3 : Term} : Deriv t1 t2 → Deriv t2 t3 → Deriv t1 t3
  | congr_s0 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s0 t) (Term.s0 t')
  | congr_s1 {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.s1 t) (Term.s1 t')
  | congr_cat {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.cat t1 t2) (Term.cat t1' t2')
  | congr_smash {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.smash t1 t2) (Term.smash t1' t2')
  | congr_tr {t t' : Term} : Deriv t t' → Deriv (Term.tr t) (Term.tr t')
  | congr_itr {t1 t1' t2 t2' : Term} :
      Deriv t1 t1' → Deriv t2 t2' → Deriv (Term.itr t1 t2) (Term.itr t1' t2')
  | congr_app (f : String) {args args' : List Term} :
      List.Forall₂ Deriv args args' → Deriv (Term.app f args) (Term.app f args')
